title: Social-Media-bedingte digitale Erreichbarkeit und psychisches Wohlbefinden von Jugendlichen
author: Lucia Hager

steps.title: Define Inclusion Criteria
steps.instruction: Establish the criteria for study selection based on the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Population: Adolescents aged 10 to 19 years
Concept: Social-media-related digital availability and its relationship with psychological well-being
Context: Everyday, non-clinical use of social media
Study Designs: Empirical studies (quantitative, qualitative, or mixed methods; primary and secondary)
Language: German and English
Publication Date: From 2010 onwards

steps.title: Conduct Literature Search
steps.instruction: Perform a comprehensive search for literature using the three-stage Joanna Briggs Institute methodology across specified databases.

substeps.instruction: Search the following databases: MEDLINE (via PubMed), PsycINFO (via EBSCOhost), CINAHL (via EBSCOhost), PubPsych, and Web of Science
Stage 1: Conduct an initial search in MEDLINE (via PubMed) and CINAHL (via EBSCOhost) to identify relevant search terms
Stage 2: Apply a comprehensive search strategy across all identified databases
Stage 3: Manually review reference lists of included studies and relevant reviews, and search for grey literature
Document any adjustments made to the search strategy during the process

steps.title: Manage References and Remove Duplicates
steps.instruction: Import and organize identified references using the Rayyan web-based screening software.

substeps.instruction: Import references into Rayyan
Remove duplicate entries
Procure full texts via university libraries or by contacting authors

steps.title: Screen Studies
steps.instruction: Select relevant studies through a two-phase screening process conducted by two independent reviewers (LH and EP) in blinded mode.

substeps.instruction: Perform a pilot screening to ensure a shared understanding of inclusion criteria
Phase 1: Screen titles and abstracts to identify potentially relevant studies
Phase 2: Perform full-text review based on the complete inclusion criteria
Resolve disagreements through discussion or by consulting a third person (PR)
Document reasons for study exclusion

steps.title: Extract Data
steps.instruction: Extract data from the included studies using a standardized data extraction form, performed by two independent reviewers.

substeps.instruction: Record authors, publication year, study design, population, outcomes, relationships, and recommendations for action

steps.title: Analyze and Synthesize Data
steps.instruction: Evaluate the extracted data descriptively and structure it thematically based on the research sub-questions.

substeps.instruction: Note: Do not perform a critical appraisal of the methodological quality of the included studies

steps.title: Report Results
steps.instruction: Present the findings narratively and tabularly according to PRISMA-ScR guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Create a flow diagram based on the updated PRISMA structure to illustrate the selection process, separating database searches from other search methods
